item.title: The JC3 remains committed to advancing the climate agenda through coordinated and collaborative efforts
item.description: The Climate Finance Innovation Lab (CFIL) launched on 18 June 2025 aims to serve as a collaborative platform to identify, develop and accelerate innovative climate solutions and mechanisms that can mobilise private and public finance to support Malaysia’s transition to net zero.

item.title: BNM–SC Joint Launch: Climate Finance Innovation Lab
item.description: Climate change poses real risks to the economy and financial system. In response to the increasing threats of climate change, Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) and the Securities Commission Malaysia (SC) jointly launched the Climate Finance Innovation Lab (CFIL) to drive innovative climate finance solutions in Malaysia.

item.title: Publication of 'Building Supply Chain Resilience: Insights into Greening Value Chains for ASEAzN' Playbook
item.description: The adoption of sustainable, green and low-carbon practices will help SMEs future proof business plans, retain market access and gain a competitive advantage as Malaysia and the world transition to a net zero and sustainable future.

item.title: Sustainable Finance and Climate Action Pledged
item.description: Bank Negara Malaysia today reaffirmed its commitment to advancing sustainable finance and strengthening climate resilience across Malaysia’s financial system. The central bank announced several measures to accelerate the country’s transition toward a low-carbon and climate-resilient economy.
